meta.description: Registry for bounded recurrence-basin stability conditions and preservation in Phase 3.

stability_entries.name: Bounded Recurrence-Basin Stability
stability_entries.purpose: Strengthen local recurrence-basin retention rules after RC-003 scaffolding.

stability_conditions.name: bounded_iteration_domain
stability_conditions.description: The sequence of recursive updates remains within a finite composition length or locally closed neighborhood.

stability_conditions.name: basin_membership_preserved_under_update
stability_conditions.description: Admissible continuation maps process states back into the declared recurrence basin.

stability_conditions.name: orientation_drift_below_escape_threshold
stability_conditions.description: Orientation frame deviation remains small enough to prevent basin escape or regime switching.

stability_conditions.name: transport_flux_finite
stability_conditions.description: The measure of realizing events propagated per update does not diverge.

stability_conditions.name: residue_accumulation_not_saturated
stability_conditions.description: Residue update sequence remains below the saturation point where admissibility collapses.

stability_conditions.name: admissibility_window_not_collapsed
stability_conditions.description: Recursion does not result in an empty admissible image A.

stability_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_at_least_one_required_witness
stability_conditions.description: Selection and pruning rules always leave a non-empty admissible candidate set.

stability_conditions.name: perturbation_response_remains_bounded
stability_conditions.description: Finite input perturbations do not result in unbounded state or admissibility drift.
